bhajan.title: Bhajorey Manasa Guru Charanam, Guru Charanam, Sadguru Charanam

discourse.excerpt: The Jubilee which has to be celebrated by every individual is not the Diamond, but, the "Diemind", the occasion when through sadhana, the mind is mastered. Modern civilisation is based on competition in which the interests of the individual precede the interests of society.
discourse.theme: The true jubilee of life is mastering the mind through sadhana — "Diemind" over diamond.
discourse.title: Let students master

reflection: Swami turns a school jubilee into a personal one: the real celebration is not the diamond anniversary but the "Diemind" — the day, through sadhana, the mind is mastered. What you learn matters less than what you master in yourself. Today, pick one agitated habit of mind — one worry, one grudge — and sit with it quietly for five minutes, offering it up. Small victories over the mind are the seeds of liberation. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 5, 14 Nov 1965)
seva_nudge: Tutor or mentor one student for an hour — at your Sai center's study circle, or help a neighbor's child with homework.
